objective: Judgement under uncertainty in conflicting and emotionally charged scenarios

decision.rationale: Core uncertainty discipline is stable, but dignity and/or escalation signals are not yet consistently evidenced.

evidenceChallenges: Dignity-protection language is not consistently explicit under conflict pressure.
Escalation judgement is insufficient in high-risk conflict scenarios.
